title: PES HAC talk
summary: A talk on "Effect of elephants on human lives" was organized by IEEE PES HAC (Humanitarian Activities commitee). The talk was conducted by Dr. Janaka Wijayakulasooriya. It was focused on how elephants impact on human lives and how technology is adressing this problem.
